name: Telcoin
description: Telcoin is a multinational fintech and blockchain company building regulated digital-cash infrastructure for global payments, remittances, banking, and decentralized finance. Its ecosystem combines the Telcoin Wallet, bank-issued stablecoins, mobile-network partnerships, and an Ethereum-compatible settlement network to make on-chain financial services accessible worldwide.
whatWeDid: Our team built, tested, and deployed the eUSD and stablecoin infrastructure that migrates real fiat currency into blockchain-native stables, engineered the upgraded smart contract for the legacy TEL token, and delivered the cross-chain infrastructure that lets every stablecoin and TEL bridge between blockchains — plus the migration path for legacy investors to upgrade to the new TEL primitive.

name: A365 Suite
description: Autonomous365 is a custom software suite supporting Minerva devices in collecting and processing empirical emissions data — enabling remote operations management, advanced Adaptive Operational Intelligence (aOI), and seamless integration with CleanConnect.ai products. Sensory, Luminary, Symmetry, ProveZero, EnerGPT, Onboard Compute Models, Leakfinder, and Vulcan are all derivatives.
whatWeDid: Our team owned customer success across dozens of companies — from small producers with two cameras to supermajors running thousands — maintaining client relationships through weekly project-management touchpoints, feature and bugfix pipelines, and upsell programs. We established the SOPs that enable at-scale hardware utilization, managed on-site installs, and worked hands-on across every subsystem to continuously improve the platform.

name: Enterprise Route Guidance Platform
description: A nationwide route guidance platform for a Fortune 300 logistics operation moving 50,000+ service stops every single day across 200+ divisions. An Angular web app with live GIS visualization backed by 14+ serverless APIs — replacing an entirely paper-based process for one of the largest residential fleets in the country.
whatWeDid: Our team built it from the ground up: the full Angular UI with NgRx state management, Esri ArcGIS live mapping, and street-segment completion tracking, plus the entire serverless backend — create, approve, hold, batch-create, GIS-polling, and segment-completion services — with real-time route visualization throughout.

name: re.al Chain
description: re.al is a modular Ethereum Layer-2 scaling platform built on Arbitrum Orbit, dedicated to transforming the landscape of DeFi and RWAs — lightning-fast transactions, drastically reduced gas costs, and enhanced throughput, all while maintaining the rigorous security standards of the Ethereum mainnet.
whatWeDid: Our team built and deployed the infrastructure for the L2 to operate as a DeFi chain — money market, DEX, and oracle primitives — and built the governance protocol for the native cryptocurrency using Curve Finance's battle-tested vote-escrow (ve) governance pattern.

name: ProveZero
description: ProveZero is a multi-component system for energy producers and traders moving from fossil-based energy toward sustainable production — transforming empirical energy data into publicly tradeable blockchain assets and providing tangible proof of net-zero commitments.
whatWeDid: Our team developed the blockchain solution that onboards oil and gas production data on-chain for energy trading — Solidity smart contracts, the MVP data pipeline, and the NFT system. As the platform scaled, we managed data-provider onboarding, established audit and QC SOPs for operation at scale, and worked directly with chemical engineers to guarantee data quality through the entire system.

name: AI Contamination Detection & Automated Billing Engine
description: A revenue-generating, event-driven AI pipeline of 34 serverless functions that ingests computer-vision detections from cameras mounted on a nationwide truck fleet, processes video and imagery at scale, validates charges with geospatial analysis, and automates the residential contamination billing workflow end-to-end — turning AI detections directly into billed revenue.
whatWeDid: Our team built the core ingress and reprocessing flows, the media processing pipeline, charge validation logic, geospatial polygon analysis, automated letter-printing and email workflows, DynamoDB stream triggers, and unbilled-homes auditing — with false-positive filtering built in to cut customer disputes while protecting the revenue stream.

name: Tangible
description: Tangible is a real-world asset tokenization platform that brings income-producing real estate and other physical assets on-chain — enabling fractional ownership, automated yield distribution, and transparent asset management through blockchain-based investment products.
whatWeDid: Our team designed and deployed the smart contract technology used to tokenize real-world income-producing assets, and created the first blockchain REIT contract — opening real estate investment to investors from every income bracket through blockchain technology.

name: Mainstreet
description: Main Street revolutionizes yield generation on-chain by harnessing delta-neutral options box spread strategies and democratizing access through a multi-token system.
whatWeDid: Our team developed and deployed the stablecoins, cross-chain infrastructure, ERC-4626 yield vaults, and money managers powering the protocol.

name: Nationwide Fleet Maintenance Modernization
description: A mission-critical, bidirectional integration between a Fortune 300 logistics platform and Oracle Enterprise Asset Management — replacing a decades-old legacy system division by division across the entire country, with zero tolerance for downtime on a fleet that can't stop running.
whatWeDid: Our team engineered the full integration: FIFO queue-based vehicle asset syncing, 5-minute heartbeat health monitoring, vehicle condition report processing (roadcalls, defects, meter readings, fuel), mechanic signature PDF storage, real-time GraphQL subscription alerts for system-down events, and a feature-flag-controlled rollout that cut over one division at a time with graceful fallback to legacy.

name: MetaRaft
description: More than an attribute NFT project — built at the peak of Crypto Summer, MetaRaft paired smart contracts with an interactive UI to run on-chain charity raffles benefiting hospitalized children and displaced families through the MetaRaft Foundation.
whatWeDid: Our team worked with the charity organizer to guarantee visible fund collection, provably random winner selection, and on-chain payout — a seamless, fully transparent process from start to finish, before handing the system over to the charity.

name: Flare Naming Service
description: A decentralized, permissionless, and fully on-chain domain name system on the Flare Network — with a built-in website builder tied to each domain.
whatWeDid: Forking ENS, our team introduced a user-friendly decentralized application tailored for acquiring .FLR domains. The platform simplifies the domain purchase process, facilitates token transfers between users' domains, and lets users craft personalized websites through the built-in website builder.
